verdict.rationale:
Fivetran's core model is a no-code/dashboard-managed SaaS pipeline platform, not a git-versioned code-first system; most connectors are configured via UI, not repo files. However, the Connector SDK lets engineers write custom connectors in Python that can live in their own repo, and the REST API enables programmatic/automatable setup, giving partial code-first portability for custom cases only.
missing for 10: evidence of declarative pipeline-as-config (e.g. Terraform provider or YAML manifests) for standard connectors, evidence of code review/PR workflows applied to pipeline definitions, and confirmation that core connection configs (not just custom SDK connectors) are stored/portable as repo files.
